title: [ALAppExtensions #30294][Event Change Request] Report 12121 "G/L Book - Print" - "OnPreDataItemOnAfterSetGLBookEntryFilters"
summary: A new integration event is added to the G/L Book - Print report that allows partners to set custom filters on G/L Book Entry before validation runs.
key_points: Event fires after standard filters are set but before FindFirst() validation
Partners can add custom filters through subscription
No behavior change when event is unsubscribed
Additive change with no impact on existing functionality
